long_biography.plain_text:
At Konzertgesellschaft München, aviation entrepreneur Conrado Dornier helps govern an organisation that supports young musical talent. His tastes span jazz, classical, Brazilian and Latin music, an enthusiasm dating from his youth. He also serves on the advisory board of Stiftung Neues Konzerthaus München, which supports a new concert hall and music education.

The Seastar aircraft project began for him as a promise to his father, Claudius. His wife, the lawyer Martine Dornier-Tiefenthaler, scrutinised contracts and insisted on finding partners able to share the investment before risking their entire fortune. After a prolonged search, Chinese industrial partners acquired majority ownership and provided capital to continue the programme.
